analysis.headline: Health Care and European Equities Lead Broadening Market Strength While Growth and Latin America Lag
analysis.market_regime: Selective Defensive & Value Leadership with Sector Level Divergences
analysis.executive_summary: Global rotation signals indicate pronounced relative strength concentrated in Health Care (XLV, IXJ, XPH) and European developed markets (FEZ, EPOL), alongside reacceleration in Biotechnology (XBI). U.S. Large-Cap Value (IWD) maintains direct pair leadership over Large-Cap Growth (IWF) with a 63-bar pair performance spread of 12.26 percentage points, while Equal-Weight S&P 500 (RSP) shows a pending leading pair signal over Cap-Weight SPY. Conversely, Latin American equities (ILF, EWZ) and defensive sub-groups such as Utilities (XLU) and Food & Beverage (PBJ) exhibit sustained rotation-out conditions.

cross_market_confirmations: Health Care leadership is confirmed across domestic sector (XLV), global sector (IXJ), pharmaceuticals (XPH), and biotechnology (XBI).
European strength is confirmed across regional blue chips (FEZ) and single-country leaders like Poland (EPOL) and Ireland (EIRL).
Value over Growth relative leadership is confirmed by IWD vs IWF pair spreads alongside equal-weight RSP outperforming cap-weight SPY.
risks_or_conflicts: In Health Care, IHI shows strong 20-bar score improvement (+60.07) while IHF deteriorates (-39.27).
In Industrials, ITA demonstrates strong 20-bar score improvement (+43.60) while IYT deteriorates (-30.76).
In Communication Services, IYZ exhibits 20-bar score improvement (+35.49) while IXP deteriorates (-24.38).
In Information Technology, IGV shows 20-bar score improvement (+35.23) while CIBR deteriorates (-23.65).
In Consumer Staples, XLP displays 20-bar score improvement (+24.55) while PBJ deteriorates (-32.75).
In Consumer Discretionary, XHB shows 20-bar score improvement (+28.23) while XRT deteriorates (-25.34).

IWD exhibits a pair state tension: its confirmed trend state is WEAKENING (score 87.52, score_change_20 of +34.40) due to cross-sectional score ranking history, whereas its direct pair signal against paired_ticker IWF is PAIR_LEADING with positive pair performance spreads over 20 bars (+3.10 pct pts) and 63 bars (+12.26 pct pts).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
